slides.title: Short track races are won off the ice
slides.sub: A calm routine for race week and race day

slides.title: Race week: change nothing new
slides.body: Sharpen and deburr early in race week, then skate at least one session on the fresh edge. If your bend, rocker and pitch feel right, leave them alone.

slides.title: Recheck every cup bolt
slides.body: Cups can loosen slowly under side load and vibration. Snug every bolt to your usual feel and make sure adapters and spacers sit square.

slides.title: Three windows, three job lists
slides.caption: Race week, the night before and the hour before each have their own checks.

slides.title: Pack from a written list
slides.body: Boots and guards where you can reach them, safety kit on top, tools and spares at the bottom. Keep a tool roll with spare bolts, laces, glove tips and a deburr stone.

slides.title: Protect your edges between heats
slides.body: Wipe the blades dry before every heat, slide soakers back on the moment you step off, and never walk on bare blades on matting or concrete.

slides.text: Change nothing that your body has to relearn.
